nodes.message:
Hi, we’re Tripo.

Still asking teammates to resend the same character or prop file?

Tripo Studio Team Plan gives your game team a shared workspace to create and organize character and prop models. Authorized teammates can find and reuse those assets, rather than request another file handoff.

See the workflow, or leave your details to discuss a team trial. Tripo will follow up about your team's needs and trial availability.
nodes.messageZh:
你好，我们是 Tripo。

还在请同事重复发送同一个角色或道具文件吗？

Tripo Studio 团队版提供共享工作区，让游戏团队创建并整理角色与道具模型。授权成员可以查找并复用这些资产，减少重复索要和交接文件的操作。

可以先了解工作流程，也可以留下联系方式，沟通团队试用。Tripo 官方团队将跟进团队需求及试用安排。

nodes.labelZh: 回复 · 创建、集中管理与复用
nodes.message:
Create character and prop models in the team workspace, then organize them in the library. Authorized teammates can find shared models and reuse them for another task.

Keep review and refinement in the tools your team already uses. The shared workspace supports asset handoffs; it does not replace project-specific quality checks.
nodes.messageZh:
在团队工作区创建角色与道具模型，再集中整理到资产库中。授权成员可以找到共享模型，并在后续任务中复用。

审核与完善仍放在团队已有的工具里。共享工作区支持资产交接，但不能替代项目所需的质量检查。

nodes.labelZh: 回复 · 用同一份资产清单评估
nodes.message:
Choose a short character and prop list from your game. Have the teammates who need those assets test how they create, find and reuse shared models.

Review each output against your project's art and technical requirements. Leave your contact details to discuss this workflow and a team trial with Tripo.
nodes.messageZh:
从自己的游戏中选一份简短的角色与道具清单，让需要这些资产的成员测试创建、查找和复用共享模型的过程。

再按项目的美术与技术要求评估每个输出。留下联系方式，与 Tripo 官方团队沟通这项工作流程及团队试用。

nodes.message:
Hi, we’re Tripo.

Which character and prop assets does your game project need?

Tripo Studio Team Plan lets your team create and organize character and prop models in a shared workspace. Review and refine the assets in your existing tools, then use the models that meet the project's requirements.

See the workflow, or leave your details to discuss a team trial. Tripo will follow up about your team's needs and trial availability.
nodes.messageZh:
你好，我们是 Tripo。

游戏项目需要哪些角色与道具资产？

Tripo Studio 团队版让团队在共享工作区中创建并整理角色与道具模型。先在已有工具中检查和完善资产，再把符合项目要求的模型用于项目。

可以先了解工作流程，也可以留下联系方式，沟通团队试用。Tripo 官方团队将跟进团队需求及试用安排。

nodes.labelZh: 回复 · 资产用于具体游戏项目
nodes.message:
Start with the characters and props your game project needs. Create starting models and organize them in the team library so authorized teammates can find them.

Your team checks and refines the assets, then tests their use in the project with its existing tools. This is an example workflow, not a claim about a completed customer game.
nodes.messageZh:
从游戏项目需要的角色与道具出发，创建初始模型并整理到团队资产库，方便授权成员查找。

由团队检查、完善资产，再通过已有工具测试它们在项目中的用途。这是流程示例，不是在宣称已有客户用它完成了一款游戏。

nodes.labelZh: 回复 · 按项目用途评估
nodes.message:
Choose a small part of your game project's asset list. Define how the characters or props will be used, along with the visual and technical requirements.

Evaluate model fit and how the team accesses shared assets. Leave your contact details to discuss the project and trial options with Tripo. Generation alone does not complete the game.
nodes.messageZh:
从游戏项目的资产清单中选取一小部分，明确角色或道具的用途，以及美术和技术要求。

评估模型是否适用，以及团队访问共享资产的过程。留下联系方式，与 Tripo 官方团队沟通项目和试用安排。生成资产本身不等于完成游戏。

nodes.labelZh: 开场 · 同一诉求的不同表达
nodes.message:
Hi, we’re Tripo.

Move from character and prop ideas to models your team can develop.

Tripo Studio Team Plan lets your team create and organize character and prop models in a shared workspace. Review and refine the assets in your existing tools, then use the models that meet the project's requirements.

See the workflow, or leave your details to discuss a team trial. Tripo will follow up about your team's needs and trial availability.
nodes.messageZh:
你好，我们是 Tripo。

把角色与道具想法转成模型，供团队继续完善。

Tripo Studio 团队版让团队在共享工作区中创建并整理角色与道具模型。先在已有工具中检查和完善资产，再把符合项目要求的模型用于项目。

可以先了解工作流程，也可以留下联系方式，沟通团队试用。Tripo 官方团队将跟进团队需求及试用安排。

nodes.labelZh: 回复 · 资产用于具体游戏项目
nodes.message:
Start with the characters and props your game project needs. Create starting models and organize them in the team library so authorized teammates can find them.

Your team checks and refines the assets, then tests their use in the project with its existing tools. This is an example workflow, not a claim about a completed customer game.
nodes.messageZh:
从游戏项目需要的角色与道具出发，创建初始模型并整理到团队资产库，方便授权成员查找。

由团队检查、完善资产，再通过已有工具测试它们在项目中的用途。这是流程示例，不是在宣称已有客户用它完成了一款游戏。

nodes.labelZh: 回复 · 按项目用途评估
nodes.message:
Choose a small part of your game project's asset list. Define how the characters or props will be used, along with the visual and technical requirements.

Evaluate model fit and how the team accesses shared assets. Leave your contact details to discuss the project and trial options with Tripo. Generation alone does not complete the game.
nodes.messageZh:
从游戏项目的资产清单中选取一小部分，明确角色或道具的用途，以及美术和技术要求。

评估模型是否适用，以及团队访问共享资产的过程。留下联系方式，与 Tripo 官方团队沟通项目和试用安排。生成资产本身不等于完成游戏。

variants.job: 把 3D 生成接入自己的游戏工具或资产制作流程，提交任务、查询状态、取回模型，再进入后续使用。

variants.footerZh: 工具接入由你的团队实现，生成模型仍须按项目要求进行检查。

variants.subject: Can 3D generation fit your asset workflow?
variants.subjectZh: 3D 生成能否接入你的资产流程？

nodes.labelZh: 开场 · 同一诉求的不同表达
nodes.message:
Hi, I’m with Tripo.

Still moving between 3D generation and your game or asset tools?

Tripo API lets your tool submit a generation task, check its status and retrieve the model after success. Your team builds the integration, then reviews and develops the result in its existing game or asset tools.

See the workflow, or open the Quick Start.
nodes.messageZh:
你好，我来自 Tripo。

还在 3D 生成与游戏或资产工具之间来回切换吗？

Tripo API 让自有工具提交生成任务、查询状态，并在成功后取回模型。由团队实现工具接入，再在已有的游戏或资产工具中检查并完善结果。

可以先了解工作流程，也可以打开 Quick Start。

buttons.label: See the API workflow
buttons.labelZh: 了解 API 工作流程

nodes.labelZh: 回复 · 提交、跟踪和取回模型
nodes.message:
Your tool submits a generation request and receives a task ID. Track the task's status and retrieve the model after success.

Connect the result to your existing asset review and refinement steps. Your team builds the integration and checks the model for its intended game or asset workflow; a successful task is not production approval.
nodes.messageZh:
你的工具提交生成请求并收到任务 ID，跟踪任务状态，在成功后取回模型。

再将结果衔接到已有的资产审核和完善步骤。接入由团队实现，模型也需按实际游戏或资产流程检查；任务成功不等于通过生产验收。

nodes.labelZh: 回复 · 验证一条完整请求链路
nodes.message:
Choose one asset request and define where its result should enter your tool or asset workflow. Test submission, status handling and retrieval, including what happens if a task fails.

Then inspect the model against your project's requirements before using it. The Quick Start provides request and response examples for this first integration check.
nodes.messageZh:
选择一项资产请求，明确结果应进入工具或资产流程的哪个环节。测试提交、状态处理和结果取回，包括任务失败时的处理。

随后按项目要求检查模型，再用于后续工作。Quick Start 提供请求与响应示例，便于验证首次接入。

nodes.labelZh: 开场 · 同一诉求的不同表达
nodes.message:
Hi, I’m with Tripo.

Want to add 3D models to product displays in your content platform?

Use Tripo API to generate a model from a product reference image. Your team reviews the result, then builds the integration to use approved assets for product display in its own content platform.

See the workflow, or open the Quick Start.
nodes.messageZh:
你好，我来自 Tripo。

想为内容平台中的产品展示加入 3D 模型吗？

用 Tripo API 根据产品参考图片生成模型。由团队审核结果，再实现接入，把验收通过的资产用于自有内容平台的产品展示。

可以先了解工作流程，也可以打开 Quick Start。

nodes.labelZh: 回复 · 从生成到产品展示
nodes.message:
Your content platform submits a generation task, checks its status and retrieves the model after success. Review it against the actual product before using it in a display.

Your team connects the approved model to its own product display experience. The API supplies generation; the display integration is yours to build.
nodes.messageZh:
企业自己的内容平台提交生成任务、查询状态，并在成功后取回模型。在用于展示前，先与实际产品核对。

由团队把通过检查的模型接入自己的产品展示体验。API 提供生成能力，展示接入仍由调用方实现。

nodes.labelZh: 回复 · 按产品展示用途评估
nodes.message:
Choose one product and define where a 3D model would appear in your content platform. Test generation and retrieval, then check shape, details and materials against the real product.

Evaluate the model in your own display experience before wider use. It is not a guarantee of exact dimensions or a ready-made viewer.
nodes.messageZh:
选择一件产品，明确 3D 模型应出现于自有内容平台的什么位置。测试生成与取回，再将形状、细节和材质与真实产品核对。

扩大使用前，在自己的展示体验中评估模型；这不代表尺寸精确的保证，也不代表已有现成查看器。

nodes.message:
Hi, I’m with Tripo.

Give your content platform another way to show a product.

Use Tripo API to generate a model from a product reference image. Your team reviews the result, then builds the integration to use approved assets for product display in its own content platform.

See the workflow, or open the Quick Start.
nodes.messageZh:
你好，我来自 Tripo。

让内容平台多一种展示产品的方式。

用 Tripo API 根据产品参考图片生成模型。由团队审核结果，再实现接入，把验收通过的资产用于自有内容平台的产品展示。

可以先了解工作流程，也可以打开 Quick Start。

nodes.labelZh: 回复 · 从生成到产品展示
nodes.message:
Your content platform submits a generation task, checks its status and retrieves the model after success. Review it against the actual product before using it in a display.

Your team connects the approved model to its own product display experience. The API supplies generation; the display integration is yours to build.
nodes.messageZh:
企业自己的内容平台提交生成任务、查询状态，并在成功后取回模型。在用于展示前，先与实际产品核对。

由团队把通过检查的模型接入自己的产品展示体验。API 提供生成能力，展示接入仍由调用方实现。

nodes.labelZh: 回复 · 按产品展示用途评估
nodes.message:
Choose one product and define where a 3D model would appear in your content platform. Test generation and retrieval, then check shape, details and materials against the real product.

Evaluate the model in your own display experience before wider use. It is not a guarantee of exact dimensions or a ready-made viewer.
nodes.messageZh:
选择一件产品，明确 3D 模型应出现于自有内容平台的什么位置。测试生成与取回，再将形状、细节和材质与真实产品核对。

扩大使用前，在自己的展示体验中评估模型；这不代表尺寸精确的保证，也不代表已有现成查看器。
